properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.admission.max-total-payload-bytes
properties.description: Global persisted payload-byte limit. Defaults to 512 MiB.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.admission.default-lane-max-payload-bytes
properties.description: Default per-method persisted payload-byte limit. Defaults to 64 MiB.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.admission.max-single-payload-bytes
properties.description: Maximum encoded payload size for one invocation. Defaults to 1 MiB.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.admission.overflow-policy
properties.description: Admission behavior when a bounded capacity is exhausted.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.corruption-policy
properties.description: Startup behavior for confirmed MapDB header corruption.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.idempotency.retention-millis
properties.description: Retention window for completed idempotency keys. Defaults to 24 hours.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.workers.max-threads
properties.description: Shared worker pool upper bound. The runtime default is max(2, min(availableProcessors, 32)).

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.payload.summary-policy
properties.description: Controls whether stored/admin payload summaries contain no data, type data, or codec-provided data.

properties.name: asl.async.mapdb.payload.error-detail-policy
properties.description: Controls whether persisted errors contain only the exception type or also its message.
